note: MV2-3.5 deterministic factual research backstop. World's-Best-Goalkeeper annual award wins (IFFHS World's Best Goalkeeper) — a GK-specific, position-aware best-of-year recognition that the forward-heavy player-of-the-year ballots never reach, and the natural goalkeeper analogue of the existing position-balanced selections (UEFA Best Goalkeeper, FIFPro, ESM). Scope is a BOUNDED gap-fill for the consensus-great keepers the MV2-9 recon-divergence read flagged as under-credited by OUR model (etl/output/merit/RECON_DIVERGENCE.md). ONLY outright annual WINS are sourced — a runner-up / 3rd place is NOT a win and is deliberately excluded (e.g. a keeper who only placed is left where he is, never fabricated up). Each row is a citation-backed public fact: the keeper's canonical display name, nation, award year, position GK, a human detail, and a fetchable citation URL plus the specific claim. It routes through the EXISTING position_balanced_selection scorer at the same single-best-at-a-position strength as the UEFA positional award; that family is era-gated to the post-1990 annual-award era exactly as the other annual position-balanced selections, so it credits only keepers whose award fell in their playing era. NO rating numbers, rankings, OVR/channel/boost/override, NO recon values — only the award record. The conservative linker treats these rows identically to parser rows; an uncited row fails the build.
